title: Undergraduate Research Office (Case Western Reserve University)
description:
Case Western Reserve University's central Undergraduate Research Office helps students of every major get involved in faculty-mentored research and creative endeavors. It is the campus hub for finding a research mentor, discovering funded programs and summer opportunities, and learning how to get started on a research or creative project.

title: Sponsored Summer Research Programs (SSRP, Case Western Reserve University)

eligibility.eligibility_text_raw: Summer SSRP application deadline is typically mid-February.

description: The Undergraduate Research Office's Sponsored Summer Research Programs (SSRP) offer competitive, merit-based funding to CWRU undergraduates pursuing faculty-mentored research or creative work over the summer. Applicants identify a faculty mentor and project in advance; many students join faculty-led projects, especially in STEM and the social sciences, and independent projects are also supported.

title: Campus-Based Summer Research Programs (Case Western Reserve University)
